units.displayText: Ascension Sector,

units.rawText: The Great Humanoid Creation wielded its lance, clashing with Judgment, armed with a scythe and chain.
units.displayText: The Great Humanoid Creation wielded its lance, clashing with Judgment, armed with a scythe and chain.

spans.text: The Great Humanoid Creation wielded its lance, clashing with Judgment, armed with a scythe and chain.

units.rawText: Noisome.
units.displayText: Noisome.

spans.text: Noisome.

units.rawText: Judgment raised their left hand. The great chain extending all the way towards the ground accelerated upwards with formidable momentum, whirling towards the Humanoid Creation's cranium.
units.displayText: Judgment raised their left hand. The great chain extending all the way towards the ground accelerated upwards with formidable momentum, whirling towards the Humanoid Creation's cranium.

spans.text: Judgment raised their left hand. The great chain extending all the way towards the ground accelerated upwards with formidable momentum, whirling towards the Humanoid Creation's cranium.

units.rawText: <size=50>Sever!</size>
units.displayText: Sever!

spans.text: Sever!

units.rawText: Simultaneously, Judgment put into motion their right hand, making sweeping strikes with their scythe.
units.displayText: Simultaneously, Judgment put into motion their right hand, making sweeping strikes with their scythe.

spans.text: Simultaneously, Judgment put into motion their right hand, making sweeping strikes with their scythe.

units.rawText: The Great Creation realized its position, attempting to back off. It avoided the chain's lashings, but the scythe had found its mark, creating a great grotesque gash on the abdomen.
units.displayText: The Great Creation realized its position, attempting to back off. It avoided the chain's lashings, but the scythe had found its mark, creating a great grotesque gash on the abdomen.

spans.text: The Great Creation realized its position, attempting to back off. It avoided the chain's lashings, but the scythe had found its mark, creating a great grotesque gash on the abdomen.

units.rawText: Beautiful!
units.displayText: Beautiful!

spans.text: Beautiful!

units.rawText: That thing's still making too much noise for my liking, and you're celebrating far too early in any case. It's regenerating.
units.displayText: That thing's still making too much noise for my liking, and you're celebrating far too early in any case. It's regenerating.

spans.text: That thing's still making too much noise for my liking, and you're celebrating far too early in any case. It's regenerating.

units.rawText: The great humanoid shape waved its lance with one hand, nursing its wound with the other, howling all the while.
units.displayText: The great humanoid shape waved its lance with one hand, nursing its wound with the other, howling all the while.

spans.text: The great humanoid shape waved its lance with one hand, nursing its wound with the other, howling all the while.

units.rawText: Viscid blue liquid torrented downwards, visibly mending the hideous wound at a shocking pace.
units.displayText: Viscid blue liquid torrented downwards, visibly mending the hideous wound at a shocking pace.

spans.text: Viscid blue liquid torrented downwards, visibly mending the hideous wound at a shocking pace.

units.rawText: ...That method of self-repair is not unlike that used by Lesser Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: ...That method of self-repair is not unlike that used by Lesser Sanctifiers.

spans.text: ...That method of self-repair is not unlike that used by Lesser Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Do not compare us with those Daemons.
units.displayText: Do not compare us with those Daemons.

spans.text: Do not compare us with those Daemons.

units.rawText:
Fine.
...Punishment, I sense a large gathering of agents somewhere on the outskirts of this area, and I do not know why they have not moved yet.
units.displayText:
Fine.
...Punishment, I sense a large gathering of agents somewhere on the outskirts of this area, and I do not know why they have not moved yet.

spans.text:
Fine.
...Punishment, I sense a large gathering of agents somewhere on the outskirts of this area, and I do not know why they have not moved yet.

units.rawText: Punishment, I suspect some sort of trickery...
units.displayText: Punishment, I suspect some sort of trickery...

spans.text: Punishment, I suspect some sort of trickery...

units.rawText: You're worrying too much; pay attention!
units.displayText: You're worrying too much; pay attention!

spans.text: You're worrying too much; pay attention!

units.rawText: ...I understand.
units.displayText: ...I understand.

spans.text: ...I understand.

units.rawText: Ascension Sector, former Admin Center area outskirts.
units.displayText: Ascension Sector, former Admin Center area outskirts.

spans.text: Ascension Sector, former Admin Center area outskirts.

units.rawText: A standstill...? How could it be? An unsullied Deity, a being forged unto perfection, how can a Sanctifier...
units.displayText: A standstill...? How could it be? An unsullied Deity, a being forged unto perfection, how can a Sanctifier...

spans.text: A standstill...? How could it be? An unsullied Deity, a being forged unto perfection, how can a Sanctifier...

units.rawText: Was it all too hurried? If only there was a little more time and material as excellent as Lind...
units.displayText: Was it all too hurried? If only there was a little more time and material as excellent as Lind...

spans.text: Was it all too hurried? If only there was a little more time and material as excellent as Lind...

units.rawText: You were saying something about Lind?
units.displayText: You were saying something about Lind?

spans.text: You were saying something about Lind?

units.rawText: From between the ruins, Sueyoi came, emerging from dust and wreckage. His form is haggard and his state less than ideal, but nothing could hide the fury within his eyes.
units.displayText: From between the ruins, Sueyoi came, emerging from dust and wreckage. His form is haggard and his state less than ideal, but nothing could hide the fury within his eyes.

spans.text: From between the ruins, Sueyoi came, emerging from dust and wreckage. His form is haggard and his state less than ideal, but nothing could hide the fury within his eyes.

units.rawText: ...Why are you here?
units.displayText: ...Why are you here?

spans.text: ...Why are you here?

units.rawText: You'd best have a good explanation for me.
units.displayText: You'd best have a good explanation for me.

spans.text: You'd best have a good explanation for me.

units.rawText: Where is Lind? Why can I hear her cries through abnormal signals?
units.displayText: Where is Lind? Why can I hear her cries through abnormal signals?

spans.text: Where is Lind? Why can I hear her cries through abnormal signals?

units.rawText: ...I've nothing to tell you.
units.displayText: ...I've nothing to tell you.

spans.text: ...I've nothing to tell you.

units.rawText: <size=40>You better think of something!</size>
units.displayText: You better think of something!

spans.text: You better think of something!

units.rawText: Sueyoi strode towards Elaugh, lifting her by the collar, forcing her to look into his eyes.
units.displayText: Sueyoi strode towards Elaugh, lifting her by the collar, forcing her to look into his eyes.

spans.text: Sueyoi strode towards Elaugh, lifting her by the collar, forcing her to look into his eyes.

units.rawText: <size=40>TELL ME, </size><|><size=40>WHERE IS LIND?</size>
units.displayText: TELL ME, WHERE IS LIND?

spans.text: TELL ME,
WHERE IS LIND?

units.rawText: Ack—I, I...
units.displayText: Ack—I, I...

spans.text: Ack—I, I...

units.rawText: BOOM—!
units.displayText: BOOM—!

spans.text: BOOM—!

units.rawText: Midair, Judgment, and the Great Creation collide once more. At this moment in time, the world itself trembled.
units.displayText: Midair, Judgment, and the Great Creation collide once more. At this moment in time, the world itself trembled.

spans.text: Midair, Judgment, and the Great Creation collide once more. At this moment in time, the world itself trembled.

units.rawText: [Abnormal Signal Detected, Establishing Connection...]
units.displayText: [Abnormal Signal Detected, Establishing Connection...]

spans.text: [Abnormal Signal Detected, Establishing Connection...]

units.rawText: It hurts... it burns... the pain...
units.displayText: It hurts... it burns... the pain...

spans.text: It hurts... it burns... the pain...

units.rawText: Lind?!
units.displayText: Lind?!

spans.text: Lind?!

units.rawText: The Great Creation's wails and the abnormal signal appeared simultaneously, tipping Sueyoi off to something. He looked at Elaugh, incredulous, looking for some other elucidation from her.
units.displayText: The Great Creation's wails and the abnormal signal appeared simultaneously, tipping Sueyoi off to something. He looked at Elaugh, incredulous, looking for some other elucidation from her.

spans.text: The Great Creation's wails and the abnormal signal appeared simultaneously, tipping Sueyoi off to something. He looked at Elaugh, incredulous, looking for some other elucidation from her.

units.rawText: Answer me!
units.displayText: Answer me!

spans.text: Answer me!

units.rawText: Lind... she's not coming back.
units.displayText: Lind... she's not coming back.

spans.text: Lind... she's not coming back.

units.rawText: Bastard!
units.displayText: Bastard!

spans.text: Bastard!

units.rawText: The irrepressibly angry Sueyoi finally acted, putting his fist to Elaugh's face.
units.displayText: The irrepressibly angry Sueyoi finally acted, putting his fist to Elaugh's face.

spans.text: The irrepressibly angry Sueyoi finally acted, putting his fist to Elaugh's face.

units.rawText: The metal coating on her body, as if in accord, shattered into pieces.
units.displayText: The metal coating on her body, as if in accord, shattered into pieces.

spans.text: The metal coating on her body, as if in accord, shattered into pieces.

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: Elaugh gazed at the face reflected in Sueyoi's eyes, her composure shattering.
units.displayText: Elaugh gazed at the face reflected in Sueyoi's eyes, her composure shattering.

spans.text: Elaugh gazed at the face reflected in Sueyoi's eyes, her composure shattering.

units.rawText: Ascension Sector Admin Center
units.displayText: Ascension Sector Admin Center

spans.text: Ascension Sector Admin Center

units.rawText: Before Judgment's descent.
units.displayText: Before Judgment's descent.

spans.text: Before Judgment's descent.

units.rawText: This warmth to the touch was ever-so-familiar and yet so foreign.
units.displayText: This warmth to the touch was ever-so-familiar and yet so foreign.

spans.text: This warmth to the touch was ever-so-familiar and yet so foreign.

units.rawText: You're also a human facsimile...
units.displayText: You're also a human facsimile...

spans.text: You're also a human facsimile...

units.rawText: ...I can lead you to that "answer".
units.displayText: ...I can lead you to that "answer".

spans.text: ...I can lead you to that "answer".

units.rawText: Elaugh grasped the nape of Lind's neck lightly, pressing her forehead to Lind's, linking the two's neural systems with a thread.
units.displayText: Elaugh grasped the nape of Lind's neck lightly, pressing her forehead to Lind's, linking the two's neural systems with a thread.

spans.text: Elaugh grasped the nape of Lind's neck lightly, pressing her forehead to Lind's, linking the two's neural systems with a thread.

units.rawText: Soon in Lind's view, an assortment of projections appeared. From thin and frail humans, they became gargantuan beings, reaching from the heavens to the earth.
units.displayText: Soon in Lind's view, an assortment of projections appeared. From thin and frail humans, they became gargantuan beings, reaching from the heavens to the earth.

spans.text: Soon in Lind's view, an assortment of projections appeared. From thin and frail humans, they became gargantuan beings, reaching from the heavens to the earth.

units.rawText: This... is...
units.displayText: This... is...

spans.text: This... is...

units.rawText: In an age where we were limited by biomimetics and neural systems, Avram forged a new path. She surmised that we could not create humans, for we only replicated their bodies, with no learnings as to how they think.
units.displayText: In an age where we were limited by biomimetics and neural systems, Avram forged a new path. She surmised that we could not create humans, for we only replicated their bodies, with no learnings as to how they think.

spans.text: In an age where we were limited by biomimetics and neural systems, Avram forged a new path. She surmised that we could not create humans, for we only replicated their bodies, with no learnings as to how they think.

units.rawText: Thus, we began to study their culture. We began to substitute their thoughts for our own.
units.displayText: Thus, we began to study their culture. We began to substitute their thoughts for our own.

spans.text: Thus, we began to study their culture. We began to substitute their thoughts for our own.

units.rawText: Then, we discovered the limitations of humanity.
units.displayText: Then, we discovered the limitations of humanity.

spans.text: Then, we discovered the limitations of humanity.

units.rawText: Elaugh let go of Lind, an indescribable shade of zealotry in her eyes.
units.displayText: Elaugh let go of Lind, an indescribable shade of zealotry in her eyes.

spans.text: Elaugh let go of Lind, an indescribable shade of zealotry in her eyes.

units.rawText: If what we pine for is an existence capable of directing us as we walk our path in this world forgotten by man, then why must we fixate on the creation of man?
units.displayText: If what we pine for is an existence capable of directing us as we walk our path in this world forgotten by man, then why must we fixate on the creation of man?

spans.text: If what we pine for is an existence capable of directing us as we walk our path in this world forgotten by man, then why must we fixate on the creation of man?

units.rawText: Lind, there is a limit to human ability.
units.displayText: Lind, there is a limit to human ability.

spans.text: Lind, there is a limit to human ability.

units.rawText: But for a God born of the cloud, one built with blocks of zeroes and ones, no such limits exist.
units.displayText: But for a God born of the cloud, one built with blocks of zeroes and ones, no such limits exist.

spans.text: But for a God born of the cloud, one built with blocks of zeroes and ones, no such limits exist.

units.rawText: The you who can never become human, the you who was born for the sake of enduring pain...
units.displayText: The you who can never become human, the you who was born for the sake of enduring pain...

spans.text: The you who can never become human, the you who was born for the sake of enduring pain...

units.rawText: We shall all be blessed by the advent of a God.
units.displayText: We shall all be blessed by the advent of a God.

spans.text: We shall all be blessed by the advent of a God.

units.rawText: Lind has already voyaged to God's promised land. Why must you seek to bind her so?
units.displayText: Lind has already voyaged to God's promised land. Why must you seek to bind her so?

spans.text: Lind has already voyaged to God's promised land. Why must you seek to bind her so?

units.rawText: Sueyoi took a deep, deep breath, working against the rise in temperatures from his emotional systems.
units.displayText: Sueyoi took a deep, deep breath, working against the rise in temperatures from his emotional systems.

spans.text: Sueyoi took a deep, deep breath, working against the rise in temperatures from his emotional systems.

units.rawText: How do you bring Lind back?
units.displayText: How do you bring Lind back?

spans.text: How do you bring Lind back?

units.rawText: She is one with God, of the very same essence.
units.displayText: She is one with God, of the very same essence.

spans.text: She is one with God, of the very same essence.

units.rawText: Not an answer I want to hear.
units.displayText: Not an answer I want to hear.

spans.text: Not an answer I want to hear.

units.rawText: Sueyoi looked up at the altercation in midair. An altercation from the norm, he sheathed his weapon, twisting open his fingers and revealing a series of wires.
units.displayText: Sueyoi looked up at the altercation in midair. An altercation from the norm, he sheathed his weapon, twisting open his fingers and revealing a series of wires.

spans.text: Sueyoi looked up at the altercation in midair. An altercation from the norm, he sheathed his weapon, twisting open his fingers and revealing a series of wires.

units.rawText: While I was out of action on a sickbed, De Lacey bestowed upon me a wealth of knowledge about the architecture of agents against my wishes, saying that I'd be able to help myself with that knowledge in the future when I was in danger.
units.displayText: While I was out of action on a sickbed, De Lacey bestowed upon me a wealth of knowledge about the architecture of agents against my wishes, saying that I'd be able to help myself with that knowledge in the future when I was in danger.

spans.text: While I was out of action on a sickbed, De Lacey bestowed upon me a wealth of knowledge about the architecture of agents against my wishes, saying that I'd be able to help myself with that knowledge in the future when I was in danger.

units.rawText: I never wanted to hear any of her babbling, but thankfully I've come to know a good amount of some certain hidden structures within agents.
units.displayText: I never wanted to hear any of her babbling, but thankfully I've come to know a good amount of some certain hidden structures within agents.

spans.text: I never wanted to hear any of her babbling, but thankfully I've come to know a good amount of some certain hidden structures within agents.

units.rawText: I don't know what miracles this God of yours can perform, but I hope for your sake that it'll help you with these sudden pains in your neural cloud.
units.displayText: I don't know what miracles this God of yours can perform, but I hope for your sake that it'll help you with these sudden pains in your neural cloud.

spans.text: I don't know what miracles this God of yours can perform, but I hope for your sake that it'll help you with these sudden pains in your neural cloud.

units.rawText: As Sueyoi's fingers continued to sparkle and crack, Elaugh's face took on a shade of ghostly white.
units.displayText: As Sueyoi's fingers continued to sparkle and crack, Elaugh's face took on a shade of ghostly white.

spans.text: As Sueyoi's fingers continued to sparkle and crack, Elaugh's face took on a shade of ghostly white.

units.rawText: Time is short, so I'd like what comes out of your mouth next to be what I want to hear.
units.displayText: Time is short, so I'd like what comes out of your mouth next to be what I want to hear.

spans.text: Time is short, so I'd like what comes out of your mouth next to be what I want to hear.

units.rawText: Ascension Sector, former Admin Center area airspace.
units.displayText: Ascension Sector, former Admin Center area airspace.

spans.text: Ascension Sector, former Admin Center area airspace.

units.rawText: Clang—!
units.displayText: Clang—!

spans.text: Clang—!

units.rawText: Another affray was at its end. Judgment drifted backward somewhat, the light borne by the scythe and chain now dimming.
units.displayText: Another affray was at its end. Judgment drifted backward somewhat, the light borne by the scythe and chain now dimming.

spans.text: Another affray was at its end. Judgment drifted backward somewhat, the light borne by the scythe and chain now dimming.

units.rawText: [Analysis Module Operation Complete.]
units.displayText: [Analysis Module Operation Complete.]

spans.text: [Analysis Module Operation Complete.]

units.rawText: There! This thing's weakness is... what?!
units.displayText: There! This thing's weakness is... what?!

spans.text: There! This thing's weakness is... what?!

units.rawText: Steady now... you're sure the analysis materials are correct?
units.displayText: Steady now... you're sure the analysis materials are correct?

spans.text: Steady now... you're sure the analysis materials are correct?

units.rawText: I can guarantee it! These are the results of triangulation from what we collected with basic scanning, code breakdown, and the surface samples we acquired from clashing earlier!
units.displayText: I can guarantee it! These are the results of triangulation from what we collected with basic scanning, code breakdown, and the surface samples we acquired from clashing earlier!

spans.text: I can guarantee it! These are the results of triangulation from what we collected with basic scanning, code breakdown, and the surface samples we acquired from clashing earlier!

units.rawText: This thing... this thing's weakness is the Sanctifier core located in the back of its head!
units.displayText: This thing... this thing's weakness is the Sanctifier core located in the back of its head!

spans.text: This thing... this thing's weakness is the Sanctifier core located in the back of its head!

units.rawText: That's the source of the operands sustaining its movements! It's certain!
units.displayText: That's the source of the operands sustaining its movements! It's certain!

spans.text: That's the source of the operands sustaining its movements! It's certain!

units.rawText: That's why its method of self-repair is so similar to the repair fluid of Lesser Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: That's why its method of self-repair is so similar to the repair fluid of Lesser Sanctifiers.

spans.text: That's why its method of self-repair is so similar to the repair fluid of Lesser Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: We've speculated many times as to what evidence Eucharist has hidden away, but this degree is absolutely unimaginable.
units.displayText: We've speculated many times as to what evidence Eucharist has hidden away, but this degree is absolutely unimaginable.

spans.text: We've speculated many times as to what evidence Eucharist has hidden away, but this degree is absolutely unimaginable.

units.rawText: Defiling the remains of comrades, jury-rigging into the profane form of this Daemon...
units.displayText: Defiling the remains of comrades, jury-rigging into the profane form of this Daemon...

spans.text: Defiling the remains of comrades, jury-rigging into the profane form of this Daemon...

units.rawText: The two voices were one again. Judgment lowered their head as if lamenting.
units.displayText: The two voices were one again. Judgment lowered their head as if lamenting.

spans.text: The two voices were one again. Judgment lowered their head as if lamenting.

units.rawText: <color=red>O imprisoned comrade, I shall bring you absolution.</color>
units.displayText: O imprisoned comrade, I shall bring you absolution.

spans.text: O imprisoned comrade, I shall bring you absolution.

units.rawText: Ascension Sector, former Admin Center area outskirts.
units.displayText: Ascension Sector, former Admin Center area outskirts.

spans.text: Ascension Sector, former Admin Center area outskirts.

units.displayText: [Receiving Signal, Establishing Connection...]

spans.text: [Receiving Signal, Establishing Connection...]

units.rawText: Thank the heavens, finally.
units.displayText: Thank the heavens, finally.

spans.text: Thank the heavens, finally.

units.rawText: Where are you, Suu? Have you found Linny?
units.displayText: Where are you, Suu? Have you found Linny?

spans.text: Where are you, Suu? Have you found Linny?

units.rawText: I'm at the Admin Center, Elaugh's here next to me.
units.displayText: I'm at the Admin Center, Elaugh's here next to me.

spans.text: I'm at the Admin Center, Elaugh's here next to me.

units.rawText: As for Lind... long story.
units.displayText: As for Lind... long story.

spans.text: As for Lind... long story.

units.rawText: Sueyoi took some time explaining the head and tail of the situation to De Lacey.
units.displayText: Sueyoi took some time explaining the head and tail of the situation to De Lacey.

spans.text: Sueyoi took some time explaining the head and tail of the situation to De Lacey.

units.rawText: ...Be careful. I'm on the way.
units.displayText: ...Be careful. I'm on the way.

spans.text: ...Be careful. I'm on the way.

units.rawText: Did you not listen to any of that? Lind's in special circumstances, Ascension is in danger; you ought to leave...
units.displayText: Did you not listen to any of that? Lind's in special circumstances, Ascension is in danger; you ought to leave...

spans.text: Did you not listen to any of that? Lind's in special circumstances, Ascension is in danger; you ought to leave...

units.rawText: Do you know how to heal the wounded?
units.displayText: Do you know how to heal the wounded?

spans.text: Do you know how to heal the wounded?

units.rawText: Lind's current complication can't be helped with a little bit of healing...
units.displayText: Lind's current complication can't be helped with a little bit of healing...

spans.text: Lind's current complication can't be helped with a little bit of healing...

units.rawText: Wait for me.
units.displayText: Wait for me.

spans.text: Wait for me.

units.rawText: Take care, Suu. That's all. See you in a bit.
units.displayText: Take care, Suu. That's all. See you in a bit.

spans.text: Take care, Suu. That's all. See you in a bit.

units.rawText: [Communication Ended—]
units.displayText: [Communication Ended—]

spans.text: [Communication Ended—]

units.displayText: Sueyoi absently glanced at Elaugh overloading by his side, then returned his attention to the skies above.

spans.text: Sueyoi absently glanced at Elaugh overloading by his side, then returned his attention to the skies above.

units.displayText: The clash between Judgment and the Great Creation raged on.

spans.text: The clash between Judgment and the Great Creation raged on.

units.rawText: Krak—
units.displayText: Krak—

spans.text: Krak—

units.rawText: After much clamoring of machinery being disassembled, Elaugh took Lind's hand in hers, pressing it to her own body.
units.displayText: After much clamoring of machinery being disassembled, Elaugh took Lind's hand in hers, pressing it to her own body.

spans.text: After much clamoring of machinery being disassembled, Elaugh took Lind's hand in hers, pressing it to her own body.

units.rawText: Hold on, you—
units.displayText: Hold on, you—

spans.text: Hold on, you—

units.rawText: Yes... do you see it now?
units.displayText: Yes... do you see it now?

spans.text: Yes... do you see it now?

units.rawText: Rather, do you feel it now? Lind, this flesh vessel, all glitter and no substance.
units.displayText: Rather, do you feel it now? Lind, this flesh vessel, all glitter and no substance.

spans.text: Rather, do you feel it now? Lind, this flesh vessel, all glitter and no substance.
